hints.title: Numeric Comparison of Large Strings
hints.text: The integers can have up to 100 digits, so standard 64-bit integer conversion will overflow in static languages.

hints.title: Custom String Comparator
hints.text: To compare two positive numeric strings a and b: if length of a does not equal length of b, the longer string is larger; if equal length, lexicographical comparison matches numeric order.

hints.title: Ranking or Min-Heap
hints.text: Sort using the custom comparator or maintain a min-heap of size k to find the k-th largest element.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of strings in nums
complexity.notes: Sorting with length and lexicographical comparator.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Parsing 100-digit strings as 64-bit integers throws numeric overflow errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Comparing by length first then string contents avoids BigInt conversion entirely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle arbitrary-length numbers safely via custom string comparators.
